description: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of factual errors across different QA systems: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA, for three different datasets: HotpotQA, MusiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different QA system, with NoR QA in yellow, OneR QA in red, and IRCoT QA in blue. For HotpotQA, NoR QA has 15 errors, OneR QA has 10, and IRCoT QA has 5. In MusiQue, NoR QA has 29 errors, OneR QA has 23, and IRCoT QA has 14. For IIRC, NoR QA has 15 errors, OneR QA has 14, and IRCoT QA has 11. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
